mission.name: Imazu 14 -- crossing from starboard (3 targets)
mission.own_ship_role: give-way to ts1 / give-way to ts2 / give-way to ts3
mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 14, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 crosses from starboard (abeam); ts2 crosses from starboard (broad); ts3 crosses from starboard (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
